name: pers_catalyst_calendar_2026-09-25
objective: maximise 126-session return vs SPY, net of costs
strategy: I only own names with a dated catalyst inside the six-month horizon, spread across PDUFA dates (Oct 10 through Dec 30) and Q3 earnings (Oct 14 through Nov 5) so no single day decides the book. Biotech is the largest sleeve because the evidence carries primary-sourced PDUFA dates plus positive revision flow; semis and defense are the earnings-date ballast. I am wrong if a cluster of CRLs hits the biotech sleeve, or if the Oct 14-27 semicap prints guide 2027 capex down and the AI-capex chain de-rates together.

FLUT|15 net lowers and no dated catalyst in evidence
OKLO|zero revenue with 4 net lowers over 90d
SMR|6 net lowers and collapsing revenue
VRT|4 net lowers and no dated catalyst listed
ORCL|8 lowers and data-center financing headlines
BYND|meme spike with no dated catalyst
QUBT|no dated catalyst and weak factor rank
